canvas.note: Generator outputs 1536x1024. Stack vertically; engine blends 96-128px overlap.

tileTypes.BOTTOM: Only roots segment — earth at bottom, mist at top. No canopy at top edge.
tileTypes.MID: Trunk-only — mist at BOTH top and bottom. No ground, no buildings, no roots, no canopy cutoffs.
tileTypes.TOP: Canopy transition — mist at bottom only (future batches)

rules.sameTrunkSilhouette: Identical trunk width and center X across all tiles in a stack
rules.seamlessVerticalStack: Any compatible segment must connect top-to-bottom without visible breaks
rules.randomCombinable: Segments shuffle and repeat — the tree must never look like one fixed wallpaper
